sentences: Inside the CPU is a clock that ticks, like a metronome.
Every tick, the processor can move its work one step forward.
Gigahertz means billions of ticks per second.
So 4 gigahertz is four billion ticks, every single second.
But a higher number doesn't always mean a faster chip.
Newer processors get more work done on every tick, so a newer chip at 4 gigahertz can beat an older one at 5.
Clock speed is how fast it ticks, not how much it does each tick.
